tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List purchasable Instagram and TikTok services, quantity limits and starting prices in integer CZK halere. Use get_quote for an exact price.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Look up an actual public social profile using ScrapeCreators. Missing numbers are null.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: List up to 20 recent posts belonging to a profile, with URLs usable in a quote.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Calculate a server-verified price, valid for 15 minutes. Does not purchase or charge. Likes/views are divided evenly across selected posts.

tools.name: create_order
tools.description: Create an unpaid order from an accepted quote. Requires user intent to order. Return the checkout URL to the user; protect orderToken as a secret. Reuse the same idempotencyKey on retries.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Read the payment and delivery status of an order using its private token or an authorized connection. A paid order is not necessarily delivered.

tools.name: get_wallet
tools.description: Read the authenticated wallet balance and the remaining approved agent budget in integer CZK halere.

tools.name: pay_order
tools.description: Spend real prepaid credit and initiate delivery for an existing order. Requires wallet:spend authorization and a user-approved budget. Reuse idempotencyKey after timeouts; never create a replacement order to retry delivery.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "create_order" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
